nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text_en: Wukong went to Mount Potalaka and told Guanyin about the monster.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text_en: "His name is Sha Wujing," said Guanyin.
nodes.text_zh: "他的名字叫沙悟净,"观音说道。

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text_en: "He was waiting for you. He's going to help the Tang Monk reach the Western Paradise."
nodes.text_zh: "他一直在等待着你。他将帮助唐僧抵达西方极乐世界。"

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text_en: "I didn't know that!" cried Wukong.
nodes.text_zh: "我没想到!"悟空惊呼道。
